description: Defines the OrderResponse class used as a data transfer object for order information, including properties like IDs, status, timestamps, and line items.

classes.name: OrderResponse
classes.description: A DTO class representing an order response with various order details like IDs, status, timestamps, and line items.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: getMerchantStoreId
methods.description: Returns the merchant store's UUID.

methods.name: setMerchantStoreId
methods.description: Sets the merchant store's UUID.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with the order.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID associated with the order.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency code for the order.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency code for the order.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the order.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the order.

methods.name: getPaymentStatus
methods.description: Returns the payment status of the order.

methods.name: setPaymentStatus
methods.description: Sets the payment status of the order.

methods.name: getTotalAmount
methods.description: Returns the total amount for the order in minor currency units.

methods.name: setTotalAmount
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the order.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the order was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp for the order.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last update to the order.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last update timestamp for the order.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the list of order line items.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Sets the list of order line items.
